claims.object_text: clinical benefit of 4-aminopyridine in patients with KCNA2 gain-of-function variants
claims.quote: 9 of 11 patients carrying such variants benefitted from treatment with 4-aminopyridine.

claims.object_text: seizure freedom for absence, myoclonic, or atonic seizures with 4-aminopyridine
claims.quote: All six patients experiencing daily absence, myoclonic, or atonic seizures became seizure-free (except some remaining provoked seizures).

claims.object_text: variable response of generalized tonic-clonic seizures to 4-aminopyridine
claims.quote: Two of six patients experiencing generalized tonic-clonic seizures showed marked improvement, three showed no effect, and one worsening.

claims.object_text: improvement in gait, ataxia, alertness, cognition, or speech with 4-aminopyridine
claims.quote: Nine patients showed improved gait, ataxia, alertness, cognition, or speech.

claims.object_text: tolerability of 4-aminopyridine up to 2.6 mg/kg per day
claims.quote: 4-Aminopyridine was well tolerated up to 2.6 mg/kg per day.

claims.object_text: 4-aminopyridine as a promising tailored treatment for KCNA2-(gain-of-function)–encephalopathy
claims.quote: We suggest 4-aminopyridine as a promising tailored treatment in KCNA2-(gain-of-function)–encephalopathy
